review:
36 Coins is the original 6x6 slot in Wazdan's Coins series. The Grand Jackpot is 2,000x. Sticky to Infinity keeps Cluster Collector, Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols on the reels until the end of the next bonus, so the board slowly builds up before Hold the Jackpot starts.

The Cluster Collector makes the most of the 36-reel grid by gathering nearby values. Cash Infinity offers larger prizes and easier bonus entry, and Chance Level multiplies your bet for better odds. High volatility, 96.16% RTP. If you want the bigger 3,000x ceiling, 36 Coins x3000 is the follow-up. Play the 36 Coins demo free to watch the board fill up.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
